variants.B: Exact diagnostic_prompt in this card, same original bytes and provider settings. It intentionally changes task+output contract together, not prompt length alone; not an app-compatible result.

cases.diagnostic_prompt:
Read only directly visible physical game objects in this one photograph. Return compact JSON, no prose outside JSON. This is visual transcription, not a game-state reconstruction or rules task. Do not infer owners, turns, history, hidden faces, unseen objects, or legal/expected arrangements. Preserve separate physical copies. Use null for unreadable attributes or uncertain boxes; never fill a likely value. Each box is [x,y,width,height] normalized 0..1 in the original attached image, around the physical object. Do not use game-board coordinates. Short English values, no per-object explanations. Only counted physical quantity is quantity; printed numerals are not quantity.
Game: CATAN, the photographed board. Read board terrain hexes, number tokens, robber, roads, settlements, cities and coastal harbors. Do not read surrounding hands, reference cards or off-board supplies. Output {"objects":[{"id":"p1","kind":"terrain|number-token|robber|road|settlement|city|harbor|unknown","box":null,"terrain":null,"number":null,"observedColor":null}],"warnings":[]}. Terrain is forest|pasture|hills|fields|mountains|desert|null for a terrain object only. number is the visible printed numeral of a number token, otherwise null. Read each token's own orientation. observedColor is the visible physical piece color, not an owner. Do not infer missing pieces or correct the photograph from CATAN rules.

Do not infer owners, turns, history, hidden faces, unseen objects, or legal/expected arrangements. Preserve separate physical copies. Use null for unreadable attributes or uncertain boxes; never fill a likely value. Each box is [x,y,width,height] normalized 0..1 in the original attached image, around the physical object. Do not use game-board coordinates. Short English values, no per-object explanations. Only counted physical quantity is quantity; printed numerals are not quantity.
Game: Splendor, visible public table objects. Read development card fronts, noble tiles, gem tokens and visible decks/backs. Ignore unrelated non-game objects. Output {"objects":[{"id":"p1","kind":"development|noble|token|deck|unknown","box":null,"quantity":null,"points":null,"bonus":null,"cost":null,"requirements":null,"color":null}],"warnings":[]}. points is printed prestige on a card/noble front. bonus is the printed permanent gem of a development front. cost is the printed development purchase panel; requirements is the printed noble panel, separately. A legible panel is {"white":null,"blue":null,"green":null,"red":null,"black":null} with each read count replacing its null; only a positively visible absent entry is 0. An unreadable panel remains null. bonus uses white|blue|green|red|black|null. color is a token's observed white|blue|green|red|black|gold|null, never ownership. Decks/backs do not disclose front attributes. Never derive a card identity, price or bonus from artwork, row, other cards or rules.

Game: Sagrada. Read all visible physical dice on the photographed window. Output {"objects":[{"id":"p1","kind":"die","box":null,"color":null,"value":null}],"warnings":[]}. color is the observed die color. value is the pip count on the upward face only, not a side face, printed pattern under the die or reflection. Do not output player, board-cell IDs, scoring, legal-placement checks or unphotographed dice. Do not infer values from a standard pattern or neighboring dice.

freeze_before_sending: GT bytes/SHA unchanged; do not pass GT, annotated images, answers, counts or evaluated coordinates into prompts.

Existing known attributes only. Catan terrain19 + numeral18; robber/object presence reported separately. Splendor preGT market bonus and points only where preGT has a definite value/confidence, noble points separately; costs UNKNOWN unless already fixed individually. Sagrada occupied-die color17 + top-face17.

Denominator is preGT known physical attributes, not output length. Report correct/wrong/null-or-missing/ambiguous matching and false-positive objects separately. Do not treat an omitted property as 0.

Match physical object from source box/location/visible relative description, independently of predicted value. Identical values do not establish identity. No silent coordinate shifts or GT-driven output permutation. If ambiguous, report unmatched. For backward comparability also report prior reviewer correspondence separately from strict box matching.
Never score Sagrada manual cell/dieZone as missing visual values. No board-slot scoring in B; spatial support is box correspondence only.

Timing is request start to complete response, plus upstream and normalization if measured. Report input/output/reasoning usage, calculated peak cost, actual errors and all attempts. No mean accuracy claims across all120 games.
scoring.decision_rule: Diagnostic support for simpler extraction only if a case has more correct known attributes without more wrong values or false-positive objects, and coverage/matching does not decrease. Otherwise mixed/no gain/UNCLEAR. One sample per condition cannot establish reliability or release readiness.
no_claims: No model weights/vision encoder causality from one A/B.
No B normalization or app success unless separately implemented and tested.
No latency guarantees, per-game general accuracy or global120 accuracy.

writes: Research artifacts only. No product/operating changes. Raw, image and GT stay in authorized private storage; repository holds hashes and aggregate outcomes.
